name: What factors determine the cost of a residential remodeling project?

mainEntity.name: What factors determine the cost of a residential remodeling project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Residential remodeling costs depend primarily on room square footage, structural layout adjustments, and material selections. A cosmetic remodel using existing layouts and builder-grade finishes sits at the lower end of the pricing spectrum. Costs rise when you relocate plumbing lines, re-route electrical circuits, remove load-bearing framing, or select custom materials such as natural marble, specialty tile, or detailed custom trim. Gathering clear ideas of your layout priorities and fixture preferences before requesting an estimate helps a contractor provide an accurate, itemized scope of work.
acceptedAnswer.description: Remodeling costs depend on square footage, layout or structural changes, mechanical rough-ins, and the grade of finish materials like tile, paint, and trim.
